# Buuz 2.0

> Buuz 2.0 / Бууз 2.0: free, open-source phonetic typing for Mongolian. Type Latin letters on any keyboard and get Mongolian Cyrillic instantly ("sain baina uu" becomes "сайн байна уу"). Runs entirely in the browser; nothing typed is sent anywhere. Windows and macOS keyboards are coming.
> Латин үсгээр бичихэд шууд монгол кирилл болдог үнэгүй, нээлттэй эхийн хөрвүүлэгч. Бичсэн зүйл тань хаашаа ч илгээгдэхгүй. Windows, macOS-ийн гар удахгүй гарна.

Buuz 2.0 continues Buuz, the Windows input method created by Odbayar Nyamtseren (https://github.com/odbayar/buuz), with the same phonetic rules, including vowel harmony for о/ө and у/ү.

## Use it

- [Web converter](https://buuz.thetengis.com/): type Latin, copy Cyrillic. Mongolian by default, English via the EN button or ?lang=en.
- [Source code and issues](https://github.com/TengisCh/buuz): Rust core, WebAssembly build, website.

## Policies

- [Privacy notice](https://buuz.thetengis.com/privacy): converter text never leaves the device; cookieless page-view analytics only.
- [Cookie policy](https://buuz.thetengis.com/cookies)

## More

- [Full description for LLMs](https://buuz.thetengis.com/llms-full.txt): typing rules, facts, FAQ.
